import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def h(p,e): return p[0]+p[1]*(1-np.exp(-p[2]*e**p[4]))+p[3]*e**p[5]
r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(h(p,eps)-sigma,nan=1e3), np.array([-0.29,7.15,0.78,2.57,0.91,0.78]), max_nfev=400)
res=sigma-h(r.x,eps)
best=(0,0)
for w in np.linspace(0.1,6,600):
    X=np.column_stack([np.ones(300),np.sin(w*eps),np.cos(w*eps)])
    c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,res,rcond=None)
    R=1-np.var(res-X@c)/np.var(res)
    if R>best[0]: best=(R,w,c)
print('sin/cos best', best[0], best[1], best[2])
for w in [best[1]]:
    X=np.column_stack([np.ones(300),np.sin(w*eps),np.cos(w*eps),T,eps*T,1/T])
    c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,res,rcond=None); print('with T', 1-np.var(res-X@c)/np.var(res))
